# Moodle CLI 0.12.0

This release makes `courses` the command's name, ships the agent skill as a Claude Code plugin, and tells AI apps when to use each MCP tool. It also carries the 0.11.1 security fixes, which were never published on their own.

## Highlights

- **`courses` is the canonical name.** `moodle units` and `moodle projects` still work as aliases.
- **Claude Code plugin.** Install the skill and the local MCP server with two commands.
- **Better MCP tool descriptions.** Each tool says when to use it, what to use instead, and what to run next.
- **Correct mutation flags.** Forum writes, `complete`, `alerts read` and `messages read` are now marked as changes, so agents dry-run and confirm them.
- **Security fixes.** Patched build and validation dependencies, and a newer Wrangler for MCP deploys.

## Courses

```bash
moodle courses
moodle courses show UNIT
```

Help, hints and `moodle commands --json` now say `courses`. JSON field names such as `unit_id` and the MCP tool names are unchanged. A script that reads the command tree and looks for a `units` command must look for `courses`; the alias is listed under `aliases`.

## Agent skill and plugin

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add bunizao/moodle-cli
claude plugin install moodle-cli@moodle-cli
```

The plugin brings the skill and a local MCP server (`npx -y moodle-cli mcp serve`). `moodle skills add` and `npx skills add https://github.com/bunizao/moodle-cli` still install the skill alone. The skill now lives in `skills/moodle-cli/` instead of the repository root. It is shorter, says when to use it and when a request belongs to OnTrack or Ed instead, and keeps the full command list in `references/commands.md`. Submitting an assignment has its own checklist: check the limits, dry-run, ask again before `--final`, and read the status back.

## Mutation flags

`moodle commands --json` and the skill's command reference marked `threads reply`, `forums post`, `forums subscribe`, `forums unsubscribe`, `complete`, `alerts read` and `messages read` as read-only, although each one changes Moodle and asks for confirmation. They are now marked `mutating: true`. `auth login` is no longer marked, because it only writes your local session.

## Security

Dependencies used to build and validate the CLI are patched. `moodle mcp deploy` installs Wrangler 4.155.0, which fixes several advisories in its bundled HTTP client.

Use Node.js 22.23.4, 24.22.1, or 26.12.1 or newer supported security patches.
